title: Pigmented Lesion Triage Algorithm
subtitle: ABCDE, ugly duckling, dermoscopy, and biopsy threshold

steps.prompt: New, changing, symptomatic, or ugly-duckling pigmented lesion?
Low concern after clinical/dermoscopic and contextual assessment
steps.detail: An asymptomatic or apparently unchanged lesion is not automatically benign. Biopsy when diagnostic uncertainty or suspicious features remain.

steps.prompt: ABCDE asymmetry, border, color variation, diameter/evolution, or concerning dermoscopy?
Biopsy suspicious lesion with melanoma-appropriate technique
High-risk patient: prior melanoma, many atypical nevi, immunosuppression, strong family history?
Short-interval dermoscopic monitoring or biopsy depending on threshold

citations.quote: AAD melanoma guideline hub provides care guidance for melanoma diagnosis and management.
AAD ABCDE guidance summarizes clinical warning features for melanoma recognition.
